_readme: Non-residential offers. 'contract' prices are 12-month contracts billed monthly (not prepaid). Pending records render only in review builds.

agentMonthly.name: Video Starter
scope: Up to 3 agent-on-camera social videos (30–45 sec)
2 filming hours, about 60 minutes of raw footage

scope: 2 hours on site + 1 hour in studio, about 90 minutes of raw footage
Dedicated content strategist and a monthly strategy meeting
